bootstrap_unit: Complete India 0.5-degree spatial unit with all 12 months
core_metrics_note: Core-only metrics are NaN when the input contains no core-eligible spatial units.
evaluation_scope: India-wide pooled geographic cross-validation over the Stage-06 spatial-unit feature table; each prediction retains its spatial-unit ID and held-out fold.
interpretation: A positive and bootstrap-supported RMSE increase after dropping a complete mode indicates that the grouped mode contributes predictive information beyond the remaining modes and static predictors.
